Bachelor of Science - Master of Science (BS-MS) Dual Degree:

It is a five year dual degree programme for bright and motivated science students who have passed class XII. The programme integrates classroom learning with research and provides ample scope for multidisciplinary interactions. The training during the programme enables students to pursue a career in academia, R&D institutes and science based industries.

Candidates who have passed (10+2) level with Chemistry, Mathematics and Physics with marks equal or above 60% (55% for SC / ST / PwD Categories) from any board recognized by the Council of Boards of School Education (COBSE) in India, are eligible to apply.

Indian nationals / OCI / PIO / Foreign Nationals candidates are eligible to apply for IISER Aptitude Test.
